init_multigrid_schedule: init multigrid training schedule by updating cfg with multigrid hyperparameters and solver steps
update_long_cycle_shape: update long cycle training shape and batch normalization settings based on current epoch
get_long_cycle_schedule: get long cycle training schedule with base shapes and corresponding epoch counts
get_current_long_cycle_shape: get the current long cycle base shape given a schedule and epoch index
print_training_schedule: print the multigrid training schedule with long cycle index, base shape, and epochs
